items.description: Perfecto is a web application that allows users to sell and buy used bikes, with knowledge of the sellers and buyers. Perfecto partners with Strava which gives users information about the history of the bikes for sale and build a rapport between seller and buyer. This application uses the Bike Index API.
Use the Yelp Search widget to find reviews of restaurants, bars and businesses near you. Enable the Center setting to initially center the map on your location.
Loku is an application that displays local neighborhood maps and lets users explore what is happening nearby. It displays news stories and videos, events and deals.
This is a visual amazon gift explorer. It uses amazons most-wished rss feeds and similarity data from the Amazon API to suggest gifts.
Free film recommendation tool. Choose your mood, get movie suggestions, watch trailers, read info, director, cast and user reviews.
SafetyCheckSM is a mobile iPhone app that gives you a CrimeScoreSM rating at your current location.
